column1: # 术语按官方英文：Wild's Favor / Red Imp Brewery / Lower Levels Chemist / Upper Level Pharmacist / GP Mining Coop / Showcase Expansion I

column2: Distributor
While training under The Mentor you already worked the supplier reps. Controlling the supply chain puts you a step ahead.
Traits: Probably Fun
Wanderlust
If at least one customer is still queued when you close the shop, you can go out twice at night, and the first night trip does not cost you any customers.
Smelting
Start with a shabby Furnace fitted with a Blast Furnace Module and some scrap metal.
E-commerce
Unlocks Marketplace Requests from the start. One fewer buyer arrives each day, but you receive one extra marketplace request.
Built on the Dumping Grounds

Items put in the Trash Can are moved onto the ground at the Dumping Grounds right away; you can take them back before the night ends. The nightly cleaning service and everything tied to it stop working. You clean up yourself.
Tacit Understanding

Inspections are more frequent. As long as your Security reputation is above 0, inspections are always carried out by the corrupt inspector. Thieves, pickpockets and food thieves visit slightly more often.
No Trash
The Trash Can is rebuilt as a Smuggler's Bay. You clean up yourself and need no nightly cleaning service, but you can still trade through the Trash Can. You start with a Backpack (Basic).
Former Assistant
Unlocks Jackson Investment I from the start. You get a 10% trade bonus when dealing with Dr. Jackson. Once every 3 days you can call him to come and trade with your store.
Dr. Jackson
Trading with Dr. Jackson: buy price -10%
Trading with Dr. Jackson: sell price +10%
It's me. Doctor, can you drop by the store tomorrow? There is something I would like you to look at.
Deal. See you tomorrow.
Painful Phone Bill
Calls cost 20 credits. Every phone-summoned service brings 50% more goods and 25% more budget, rounded up.
Astigmatism
The magnifying glass makes things hard to see.
Five-Finger Discount
You start with 150 points of crime suspicion. You start with 300 credits worth of stolen goods.
Shawshank Redemption
You accidentally dug through the wall. The wall hole becomes 4×4 and counts as a display case instead of a hidden compartment. The display case attracts one extra buyer.
Last night's trip made you open late today. Wanderlust meant you lost no customers over it.
Newspaper Recipe
Newspapers now count as a flux agent, synthetic yeast, and a hard-to-swallow X food (75KJ).
Unappetizing
Flux agent (Basic): a practical additive that raises the purity of metal ore when used while smelting. It is consumed in the process.
Synthetic yeast: an illegal substance that can replace yeast to brew slightly carcinogenic wine very cheaply. Water is all it needs.
You buy the store at the start with a debt of 7,000.
Self-Built
You own the property from the start, but all of your nightly service fees are doubled.
Cellar
'"Wild's phone is unlocked from the start and you gain 300 Wild's Favor."'
Wild's Favor
Start with a Curing Cabinet and 2 bottles of aged wine.
Stable Partnership
All dealers come to your store on Tuesdays and Fridays instead of you ordering them by phone.
We drop the goods off on Tuesdays and Fridays. No need to call.
Mortgage
No Questions Asked
Stolen and contraband tags are removed from every item. Inspections are removed. This save cannot complete the "Clean Hands" achievement.
Share the Smoke
Offer a customer a pack of cigarettes to raise their budget and their trade reputation multiplier and gain a slight trade bonus. Genuine cigarettes give twice the benefits of counterfeits.
Share the Smoke: buy price
Share the Smoke: sell price
Serve a customer first
This customer already had a smoke with you.
Now that's the good stuff. Thanks - I can afford a bit more today.
Hm, genuine. You have taste, and you're generous.
That's the right taste. I owe you one.
...This tastes a bit off.
Whatever, it's free. Not complaining.
This thing... fine, it'll do.
Offer a Cigarette
Unlocks Red Imp Brewery, Lower Levels Chemist, Upper Level Pharmacist and GP Mining Coop.
Unlocks Showcase Expansion I.
The suppliers have already sent their free samples.
Starting credits: 100.
Dutiful Broker
Market requests and customers are more likely to ask for bulky goods you already own, especially on rent day. Market requests never ask for the same item twice.
Notorious Villain
Each neutral or negative perk you picked gives you 40 extra credits at the start. This perk counts as negative.
Cyberpsychosis
Your starting perk slot limit is increased by 3. At the start of the run this perk is replaced by a random 1-point negative perk.
I know you did something to that trash can of yours.
Strictly speaking
column3: once a trash can is used to hold goods it stops being a trash can.

column2: Business is business, so we won't clean your "trash can" - you are allowed to clean up yourself.
That said, if you would like to join the underground trade, you are still welcome.
Underground Trade
Snack Addiction
If you do not eat snacks regularly, you suffer an 8% trade penalty. The addiction can be cured... but is that really necessary?
Snack Addiction: you are craving again. Trades suffer.
Snack Addiction: you have gone long enough without snacks. You are cured.
You chew on a snack. Your hands stop shaking.
"Trash Can"
It is actually a hidden compartment, not a trash can. The cops cannot see what is inside.
This trash can has no bottom - anything you put in drops straight to the dumping grounds floor. You can take it back before the night ends.
Opening Bonus
Gain a 7% trade bonus. It drops by 1% per day until the effect is gone.
Opening Bonus: buy price -X%
Opening Bonus: sell price +X%
Supplier Side Business
Suppliers bring along goods related to their own line of business. The total value of these extra goods grows with the day count. However many byproducts you buy, it is always at wholesale price.
Wholesale price: buy price -X%
